_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Compact in Place, in a conversation started with the compact_in_place tool off, enables the tool and then asks the agent to compact. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}.
2. Click the ".context-usage-label" element, then click the [data-testid="compact-in-place-button"] button.
3. The [data-testid="message-modelchange"] element has the aria-label exactly "Enabled the compact_in_place tool." and its text contains "+compact_in_place".
4. An element with the text "Compact your context in place." is visible.
5. Call "options": it reads the conversation's stored options and must return exactly "compact_in_place=on disable_compact_nudges=true" (the tool is on, without the context nudges).
